drafted_from: tool:github:xinntao-real-esrgan's row in tools/tools-from-github/tool-rows.json (job, run, get_it, needs) and its sources row in sources.json; the command is the row's own run line with synthetic names filled in. What it prints or writes is read from the tool's documented behavior; the folder test test/index-github-tools.test.mjs only checks the row, never runs Real-ESRGAN.
start_here: Say to your AI: "Use Real-ESRGAN on my computer to upscale an image or photo to a higher resolution and restore its detail: the file is logo-small.png." It reads the row, installs Real-ESRGAN if it is missing, runs it on that one file and shows you what it made.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: Real-ESRGAN is a program that runs on the person's own computer and works on the one file or address it is handed.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Use Real-ESRGAN on logo-small.png". It reads the row with run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools, method tools:list, input {tool: "tool:github:xinntao-real-esrgan"}.

2. It checks that nothing else is on your computer, and if Real-ESRGAN is missing it runs the get_it steps: git clone https://github.com/xinntao/Real-ESRGAN.git ; download realesrgan-ncnn-vulkan for your system from the repository's releases.
3. It runs the row's command with your file in place of {input} and where the result goes in place of {output}: ./realesrgan-ncnn-vulkan -i logo-small.png -o logo-big.png -n realesrgan-x4plus
4. Read what it shows you and open the result. Trillion runs none of this; it all happens on your own computer.

worked_examples.title: Real-ESRGAN on a 256 by 256 pixel logo of a bakery
worked_examples.given: Read from tools/tools-from-github/tool-rows.json: tool:github:xinntao-real-esrgan runs on your computer, so after tools:list the AI runs, in the folder it got Real-ESRGAN in, the command line: ./realesrgan-ncnn-vulkan -i logo-small.png -o logo-big.png -n realesrgan-x4plus  (synthetic input: a 256 by 256 pixel logo of a bakery).
worked_examples.hands_back: realesrgan-ncnn-vulkan writes logo-big.png at 4 times the size (1024 by 1024) with the edges and detail restored, and prints the percentage it has done as it goes.
